description: Convert text to speech. Returns the audio file URL (valid 30 days). MiniMax (default, about $0.004 for a short line, $0.04 per 1000 characters), ElevenLabs eleven-tts-v3 / v4 / flash / turbo / multilingual (most natural, 70+ languages), Fish fish-s2.1-pro / fish-drama-3 (voice cloning library, expressive drama voices) and kling-tts. Find voices with list_voices.

extra.description: Optional model-specific parameters passed through as-is, e.g. {"voice_settings": {"stability": 0.4}} for ElevenLabs, {"audio_setting": {...}} or {"language_boost": "Chinese"} for MiniMax.

language_code.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language hint for ElevenLabs, e.g. en, zh, ja.

model.description: TTS model id: minimax-speech-02-turbo (fast), minimax-speech-02-hd, minimax-speech-2.6-hd, minimax-speech-2.8-hd / -turbo; eleven-tts-v3, eleven-tts-v4, eleven-tts-v4-turbo, eleven-tts-flash, eleven-tts-turbo, eleven-tts-multilingual; fish-s2.1-pro, fish-s2.1-pro-free, fish-drama-3; kling-tts.

save_to.description: Local server only, ElevenLabs only: also write the audio to this file path (e.g. ~/Desktop/line.mp3).

voice_id.description: Voice id from list_voices. MiniMax default English_Trustworthy_Man (others: English_Graceful_Lady, Serene_Woman, male-qn-qingse, female-tianmei). ElevenLabs default voice if omitted. Fish: pass the voice id here (sent as reference_id). kling-tts requires one.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the audio before returning a task id instead (seconds, 0–900). Default 50: Codex aborts tool calls at 60 s unless tool_timeout_sec is raised. In Claude Code / Claude Desktop you can pass up to 900 to get the URL in one call.

name: text_to_speech
